fields.description: A silk saree is a traditional Indian garment made from natural silk fibers produced by silkworms. Renowned for their strength, luxurious sheen, and breathability, these sarees are staples in Indian culture, frequently worn at weddings, festivals, and milestone celebrations, and are often cherished as family heirlooms

fields.title: About Us
fields.content:
About Our Rangam Saradha Silks

Founded in 1995 by Rangam Manjunath, Rangam Saradha Silks was established with a vision to preserve the rich heritage of Indian silk weaving while delivering exceptional quality and timeless elegance. For over three decades, we have earned the trust of thousands of customers by offering authentic silk sarees that celebrate tradition, craftsmanship, and sophistication.

At Rangam Saradha Silks, we believe that a saree is more than just a garment—it is a symbol of culture, grace, and cherished memories. Every collection is thoughtfully curated with premium-quality silk, exquisite craftsmanship, vibrant colours, and intricate designs that beautifully blend India's weaving traditions with contemporary fashion.

Our journey has always been driven by a deep respect for skilled artisans and master weavers whose dedication brings every saree to life. By supporting traditional craftsmanship, we continue to preserve generations of weaving excellence while creating designs that inspire confidence and elegance.

Whether you're celebrating a wedding, festival, special occasion, or simply embracing the beauty of everyday tradition, Rangam Saradha Silks is your trusted destination for authentic, luxurious, and timeless silk sarees. With every drape, we invite you to become a part of our legacy—a legacy woven with passion, heritage, trust, and uncompromising quality.

— Rangam Manjunath
Founder, Rangam Saradha Silks

What We Offer At Rangam Saradha Silks

For over 30 years, Rangam Saradha Silks has been a trusted name in the world of premium silk sarees. Founded by Rangam Manjunath in 1995, our journey has been dedicated to preserving the timeless beauty of Indian weaving traditions while bringing elegant, high-quality sarees to customers across India and beyond. Every collection reflects superior craftsmanship, authentic silk, and designs that blend tradition with modern elegance.

At Rangam Saradha Silks, we offer an exclusive collection of:

  • Pure Silk Sarees
  • Kanchipuram Silks
  • Bridal Sarees
  • Dharmavaram Silks
  • Designer Sarees
  • Festive Collections
  • Party Wear
  • Cotton Sarees
  • Handcrafted Traditional Weaves

Whether you shop in-store or online, you can enjoy a seamless shopping experience with secure online payments, fast and reliable shipping, dedicated customer support, quality assurance, and hassle-free service.

Every saree we create tells a story of heritage, artistry, and excellence. We proudly work alongside skilled artisans and master weavers who continue India's rich textile legacy through their craftsmanship. Our commitment is not only to provide luxurious sarees but also to support traditional weaving communities and preserve generations of artistic excellence.

From weddings and grand celebrations to festivals and everyday elegance, Rangam Saradha Silks is your trusted destination for authentic silk sarees that celebrate grace, culture, and sophistication. With every purchase, you become a part of a legacy woven with tradition, trust, quality, and timeless beauty.

— Rangam Manjunath
Founder, Rangam Saradha Silks
